segments.text:
The sanctification of the bodie is when all the members of it are carefully preserued from beeing meanes to execute any sinne: and are made the instruments of righteousnes and holines. So Paul prayed for the Thessalonians
that they might know howe to possesse their vessels in holinesse, and in honour, and not in the lust of concupiscence, as the Gentiles doe which know not God. And Iob
made a couenant with his eies not to look on a woman. In whose example it appeareth how euery member is to be kept pure and holy.
